findings.assembly: Both original-year circuits depict one common Door Lock Relay Assembly feeding both door motors, with two internal relays (lock and unlock). This is one depicted shared assembly, not two separate door-mounted units.

location.1986: Near upper RH shroud: PDF1019/8A130-1; connectors shown behind I/P at RH shroud in PDF1053/8A201-15 FigureA.
location.1987: Near upper RH shroud: PDF1014/8A130-1; connectors shown behind I/P at RH shroud in PDF1049/8A201-16 FigureA.

findings.ground: Both manuals specifically require good case grounding. Schematic shows relay contact/coil ground through the case; BLK194 at C2/A is the powered UNLOCK command, not an assumed chassis ground.

pinout.function: Battery supply from PWR ACC30A breaker
Shared motor output; battery on UNLOCK, ground on LOCK
Shared motor output; battery on LOCK, ground on UNLOCK
UNLOCK command from door switches; not a chassis-ground lead

connectorFaces1987.C1: Black three-cavity housing. Viewed exactly as printed: cavityA is left; C is upper right; B is lower right.
connectorFaces1987.C2: Gray two-cavity housing. Viewed exactly as printed: B left, A right.
connectorFaces1987.limits: Harness-connector face illustration; preserve the source view convention when modeling, rather than mirroring it into a component-terminal view. Connector service number not independently established here.

findings.operation: LOCK energizes the lock relay, placing supply on GRY295 and ground on TAN294; UNLOCK reverses these. The other relay resting contact supplies the motor return. Both motors have self-resetting circuit breakers.
